name: Ksolves India Ltd
title: Ksolves India Ltd - 543599 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 43.03 cr (+29.1% YoY, +1.7% QoQ) with FY26 EBITDA margin down to 29.7% from 34.8% on planned investments; FY27 guided 18-20% growth, 25-30% margin, and DFM product write-off-style retreat.

triggers.label: QoQ growth only 1.7% in Q4
triggers.quote: Right now, we are seeing only 1.7% quarter-on-quarter. This 1s because of the war.

triggers.label: FY27 growth 18-20% vs FY26 18.4%
triggers.quote: we expect annual revenue growth to be around 18% to 20% and EBITDA margins to be in the range of 25% to 30%

triggers.label: DFM product ~INR 2 cr expensed, no big FY27 spend
triggers.quote: approx. INR 2 crores was expensed in FY26, and we expect no further big investments on DFM development in FY27.

triggers.label: Wide 25-30% margin band, hedged
triggers.quote: considering geopolitical factors, I'm trying to be conservative, and that's why I have given you the bracket

guidance.quote: we expect annual revenue growth to be around 18% to 20%
EBITDA margins to be in the range of 25% to 30%

red_flags.label: Product (DFM) spend ~INR 2 cr with little revenue; management now says little opportunity
red_flags.quote: But still, honestly speaking, I do not see a lot of opportunity in DFM.

red_flags.label: PAT flat for three years as margins fell
red_flags.quote: our margins have been declined, due to which our PAT has been nearly identical over the last three years

red_flags.label: Wide margin band attributed to geopolitics
red_flags.quote: Considering geopolitical factors, I'm trying to be conservative

evasions.quote: We have already given the guidance range for revenues and margins.
AI 1s not a stand-alone revenue factor. It's embedded in all the technologies

evasions.topic: AI efficiency impact on employee cost
evasions.quote: we have not exactly measured, , what the results will be.
